thread:
lina: Quick alert — org-wide IAM change goes live tomorrow 09:00 UTC. New service accounts will require permission boundaries and short-lived creds. Long-lived user-managed keys will be blocked for new SAs. Existing keys need remediation or an exemption.

aj: Does this affect customer-managed Dedicated/Private deployments?
lina: No, only Redwood org-managed identities and infra pipelines. We will publish parity modules for customer-managed later.

chen: What are the immediate actions for infra owners?
lina: 1) Inventory service accounts with user-managed keys. 2) Migrate to workload identity / OIDC or STS for CI and services. 3) Stop creating JSON keys in automation. 4) If you need an exemption, open an eng-security ticket with scope and ETA.

tom: Will Terraform modules attach permission boundaries automatically?
lina: Yes new module v2.1.0 will add default boundaries; opt-out requires an approved ticket. Pin to v2.1.0+.
sarah: Jenkins and legacy CI still use JSON keys — migration playbook?
lina: Jenkins migration doc: https://internal.redwood/infra/ci-migrate. Use workload identity federation or credential-helper. Tag infra-oncall if you need help.

infra-oncall-bot: Reminder: 48h soft-audit window after enforcement start; noncompliant identities will be opened as tickets. After 48h, hard enforcement blocks new key uploads.

ops-bot: canary deploy iam-guardrails succeeded at 16:05 UTC :white_check_mark:

chen: If critical systems break during enforcement, what's the runbook?
lina: Open a ticket with prefix "iam-guardrails-incident" and @infra-oncall will triage. We have rollback playbooks and an emergency suspend process.

aj: Do we have an ownership map for SAs?
lina: Ownership CSV uploaded to the eng-security ticket. Assign owners for any unowned SAs by EOD tomorrow.

lina: Quick GCP audit hint: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=... --format='table(name,validAfterTime,validBeforeTime)'`
lina: AWS: use credential-report and filter access keys older than 90 days.

sarah: Can someone post a short step-by-step rotate-and-verify runbook?
lina: Posting runbook to ticket by 17:00 UTC.

infra-oncall-bot: Initial audit flagged 34 SAs with user-managed keys. Ticket: https://internal.redwood/engsec/tickets/RED-4399

lina: Enforcement start: 2024-12-03T09:00:00Z. Thanks — please surface blockers here.
